assign.request: Content modules: census every card/widget kind into one catalog; question, decision and quotation cards as modules placeable on any page and in an ai2 card; a module placed by one page.jsonl line.
steps: Scope, tell the two sibling teams
Place by one page.jsonl line; a page built only from lines
task.jsonl decision lines render as the Decision card

log.msg: Usage refresh skipped: the brief does not name ai/usage.json.

decision.chose: public/framework/ux/Content/ with Question/, Decision/, Quotation/ as child pages, prefix ux-content-. They hold state (a chosen option, an answer) so they are ux classes, not ui templates.
over: A new top-level framework/content/ tier (a new tier is surgery)
Extend ui/decision (ui is markup only; it cannot hold a choice)
decision.why: The ux tier rule: a template graduates when something has to be remembered between renders.

decision.chose: A click appends one line to the card's own .jsonl through the dev server's existing rpc:append.
over: A new Server rpc (Server/ is not my fence and needs a restart)
decision.why: Append already exists, is whole-line safe, and gates on public/*.jsonl.

decision.chose: A click on a module inside a card POSTs to Servex /card/append?id=<card>; on a plain page, or if that fails, the dev server's rpc:append.
decision.why: card-folders: Servex is the single writer for card folders and forwards the owner's choice to the agents attached to that card.

decision.chose: A placed module reads its log once on render and shows the latest chose/answer for its id; place() constructs new Module({page, ...data}) (page-jsonl's API).
over: Route chose lines through page.set() into the module
decision.why: Keeps the module independent of how core/Page dispatches unknown verbs; a chose line landing in page.unknown is harmless.

assign.outcome:
**Content modules landed: question, decision and quotation cards any page can place with one line, and a catalog of every card kind on the site.**

- [Card catalog](/framework/ux/Content/catalog/): 75 kinds, drawn live. 57 of them do the same job as another kind, and they use 19 different padding rules. The worst: a plain card is drawn 7 ways, chips 4 ways, an ask 3 ways.
- [Question](/framework/ux/Content/Question/), [Decision](/framework/ux/Content/Decision/), [Quotation](/framework/ux/Content/Quotation/): a click or answer appends one line to the card's own log. The latest line wins, and a choice can be changed.
- [Built from lines](/framework/ux/Content/built/): a page that is only a page.jsonl, with no page.js.
- The Decisions tab on every task page now draws the same Decision card. Before, the common legacy shape showed the word 'undefined'.

Committed as 9894e897 on worktree/page-cards. The page-jsonl team merges the shared branch.

Left: the Servex /card/append route was not live yet, so card writes fall back to the dev server's append. 4 catalog kinds stay as placeholders (layout words and live streams). Deliberately not in this task: sub-cards and converting a card's type (dashboard asks, next brief).
